Naval Fate.

Usage:
  navalfate ship new <name>...
  navalfate ship <name> move <x> <y> [--speed=<kn>]
  navalfate (-h | --help)
  navalfate --version

Options:
  -h --help     Show this screen.
  --version     Show version.
  --speed=<kn>  Speed in knots [default: 10].
  --moored      Moored (anchored) mine.
